tools.name: scan_solidity_preview
tools.description: FREE Solidity security check (Slither static analysis), no key and no wallet. Detects known vulnerability patterns (reentrancy, unchecked calls, tx.origin authorisation, arbitrary ETH sends, unprotected functions and more) and returns severity counts plus High/Medium detector names. Use after writin

tools.name: scan_solidity_full
tools.description: OPTIONAL, PAID ($1.00 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana). Structured Slither findings for Solidity: detector, impact, confidence, description and file/line locations, for fixing each issue. Without a valid x402 payment in _meta['x402/payment'] it returns the payment terms and does NOT scan or charge.

tools.name: payment_terms
tools.description: FREE. Price, recipient, network, asset and how to pay for scan_solidity_full.
